book.name: Hahatakei Haeu
book.title: Hahatakei Haeu Waliko tuah ti Haeu kola hatakei hani Jon tel aposel

content: Muhi tesol waliko ien, Holi Spirit hanamiloa ulea nga ape nga ningahi tewau aweing hean ti tone Haeu. Tin nga hong ulea lalape tenen kinax masin tangiai suhusuh. I wix ukek, “Lua hanima kapik patul lehe nga kola hani o waliko ti na i sohot muhin.”
Tuhan tehue Holi Spirit kapiti namilok ape nga ningahi tehu totoan pate tuah ti tone Haeu ti tel seilon toto.
Tanome tel seilon ien i talepalep hanowi waliko tenen pate i kamakam. Kakalini tehu totoan ien tehu poto, lalape xewaian masin leili sup ti i tai unauna na alon hokai hatalepalepa.
Tin 24 totoan tuah liai kakalini i hetekie 24 masiwi toto ien. Puxuaulato papaxaxun ma patulato hin tah tenen ani gol.
Ahuma he tehu totoan tuah xepai usil ma tangiai kuhuh. Mateiwaun tepanim huohu lul kamakam. Lato kikilami Holi Spirit, tetel pate pohen.
Mateiwaun tin masin kanitax tenen na pate tanenan ma xewan. Hinalo seilon tutu kapi tehu totoan ien, hua papan tepaun ape hua liai tepaun. Kilan pulalato, sai matalato ma tehitolato.
Tel ti lato tanoman masin tok pusi lalap axan laion, tel liai masin tok bulmakau, tel ulea kawan masin kawe seilon ma tel tapeinan masin tok keihat paun holaian.
Lato tel tel hina paulato masin pai manixux tuahe paulato tepanim tehu. Kilan pulalato he paulato, patul ma hahitakan. Ngain ma ipong lato to kakak ukek,

content.text: “Haeu tel Masiwi i sawisawin tapein ma tel poh tapein.
I hoi liai ti imat, aope ma tin i luluainima tutuen!”

content: Tapai na tesol hinalo seilon ien kak kemulik ma haxawa axe tetel i toto he tehu totoan tuah, tesol 24 masiwi lawe lato lokuha lakua mateiwaun ape lotui i, tetel tap tahi matean. Tesol tah he patulato ti kolai masiwialato, lato hana xaxaweni hani mateiwai tehu totoan pate tuah. Ape lato ukek,

content.text: nake o tetel tanomiai lawe waliko.
